The core problem
The core problem

Why invest?

Because “safe money” can still lose value.

Saving stores money

Useful for near-term needs and emergencies.

Investing grows money

Useful when goals are years away.

Investment objective = beat inflation + achieve goals + manage risk
🤔
If prices double, what happens to your “saved” money?
Saving and investing have different jobs.04

Understand the trade-off
Understand the trade-off

Returns come with risk

Higher return potential usually means higher uncertainty.

Low risk

Savings / FD

Lower return potential
Lower volatility

Medium risk

Debt / Hybrid

Moderate return potential
Some volatility

High risk

Equity

Higher return potential
Higher volatility

Ownership mindset
Ownership mindset

Why equity matters

Equity = partial ownership in a business.

Business growth

Shareholders can participate as good businesses grow.

Compounding

Growth on growth becomes powerful over long periods.

Inflation hedge

Equity can help long-term goals keep pace with prices.

Risk control

Diversify, invest regularly, keep a long horizon.

🌱
Think: Which Indian business do you use every week?
Equity is ownership, not a guaranteed-return product.09
Behaviour > prediction
Behaviour > prediction

Four survival rules

1

Start early

Time can do heavy lifting.

2

Diversify

Do not let one company decide your future.

3

Invest regularly

Consistency reduces the pressure to time perfectly.

4

Stay informed

Understand risk, cost, tax and suitability.

Protection before growth
Protection before growth

Life insurance protects income

The purpose is protection, not return.

Who needs it?

Anyone whose family depends on their income or future contribution.

What to prefer?

Understand pure protection and keep investment objectives clear.

How to think?

Income replacement, liabilities and future goals.

Discussion

Investment or safety net?

Protection-gap illustration

Simple protection gap₹1.00 crEducational illustration only; actual needs require a fuller assessment.
Insurance is a risk-transfer tool, not a guaranteed wealth-building shortcut.11

One medical emergency can disturb years of savings.

Coverage

Exclusions

Waiting periods
